motif_derivation.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit. Edit target: the provided approved detailed completion image A-r01, a great spotted woodpecker. Create exactly ONE simplified MOTIF SOURCE ILLUSTRATION MA-r01 derived faithfully from that image for a color nonogram around 20 wide x 30 high. This is NOT the final cell matrix: NO grid, NO pixel art, NO square mosaic, NO numbers, NO lettering.
PRESERVE: full image composition and portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, the same upright left-facing woodpecker in side profile with pointed beak to left, black cap and red nape, ivory cheek and black moustache, broad ivory shoulder patch, folded patterned wing, warm ivory breast, scarlet undertail, long stiff tail pointing down beside the tree; narrow vertical brown trunk touching the right edge and the top and bottom edges, same two grasping feet with same attachment positions. Preserve relative positions and proportions; do not add scenery or new objects.
CHANGE ONLY level of detail: replace all fine feathers, hatching, shading, gradients, highlights and complex bark with broad smooth clean flat COLOR REGIONS. No feather filaments. Group the wing spots into about 4 to 5 bold simple ivory bars on dark wing; large simple shoulder patch and simple face. Eye can be a single dark dot in ivory cheek with NO highlight. Beak and feet are dark and sturdy, distinct from the brown trunk; keep a few thick readable hooked claw shapes, no tiny scales. Use the trunk as one flat warm brown region with at most two broad dark bark cut-ins, do not texture it. Eliminate black decorative fur or thin dangling lines; use crisp closed shape boundaries.
PALETTE: exactly four foreground color families: near-black charcoal #242629 for all dark feathers, outlines, beak and feet; light ivory #f0dfb7 for cheek, shoulder, breast and wing bars; saturated warm red #cf3632 for nape and undertail; medium warm brown #996438 for the trunk. Background is uniform light neutral #fffdf5 distinct from ivory. No extra foreground grey or shading colors (normal smooth antialiased edges are fine). Maintain a dark outline on light bird regions. Strong connected surfaces, clear main silhouette and large negative spaces. Quiet warm hand-drawn 2D game illustration with clean confident contours. Do not crop the beak, head or tail. The result must look recognizably like the SAME approved bird, simply with much less detail, not a new pose or new bird.

motif_revision_MA_r03.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is MA-r02, the exact edit target. Image 2 is the approved detailed A-r01, identity reference only. Create ONE new simplified motif source MA-r03. Preserve the complete 1024x1536 portrait composition and every body/wing/tail/foot/trunk shape from image 1, same left-facing upright woodpecker beside right-hand vertical brown tree trunk. Change ONLY two tiny HEAD regions: (1) Enlarge the existing dark eye dot centered at approximately x380,y152 to a solid charcoal circle about 96 pixels across, clearly on the ivory cheek, no iris, shine or outline. This is a deliberate strengthening needed to survive averaging into one cell at 23x35; do NOT keep the previous small eye. The new eye must be about 2.5 times the previous eye diameter, while retaining the same center. (2) Keep the existing outer head silhouette and red nape unchanged but make the crown black area a clean broad uninterrupted solid charcoal cap, eliminating the small ivory bump entering the crown from the forehead; the charcoal cap should visibly remain a broad black dome over the eye. Preserve ivory cheek and black moustache, original beak location/length, red nape, full shoulder patch/wing bands/ivory breast/red undertail/two feet/long tail and all negative gaps. Absolutely no other changes. Flat four color families exactly charcoal #242629, ivory #f0dfb7, red #cf3632, tree brown #996438, background #fffdf5. NO shading, gradients, brown on the bird, text, numbers, grid or pixel mosaic. Do not redraw or alter the completion image A-r01. Output one full illustration, no comparison panels.

motif_revision_r02.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: revised nonogram motif source illustration MA-r02. Image 1 is the APPROVED detailed completion artwork A-r01 (binding identity, pose, proportions and composition). Image 2 is prior abstraction MA-r01 (edit target). Create ONE corrected abstraction, portrait 2:3, suitable for 20x30 or 22x33 color rasterization, no grid, no pixel mosaic, no text. Preserve the same complete left-facing upright great spotted woodpecker, beak pointing left, same placement beside brown vertical trunk along right edge/top/bottom, same head/body/tail silhouette, two grasping foot attachment positions, ivory cheek and breast, broad ivory shoulder and grouped ivory wing bands, red nape and red undertail. Change ONLY simplification/shape strength: eliminate ALL shading, outlines of light feather regions, thin filaments, bark grooves, double contours and subcell decorations. FOUR flat exact color families: charcoal #242629, ivory #f0dfb7, red #cf3632, brown #996438. Uniform background #fffdf5. Brown ONLY on tree trunk, no brown or grey on bird. Dark bird areas must be broad solid unshaded charcoal regions. CRITICAL black crown must be a substantial 3-4-cell wide 2-cell high solid area, eye must be a substantial filled charcoal dot about 65 pixels diameter on ivory cheek at original eye location, red nape about 90px wide and 115px high at original location. Group wing bands into 3-4 broad ivory simple ovals, with thick solid charcoal between. Simplify feet to bold dark hooked shapes in the two original positions, keep negative gaps. The aim is to prevent average-downsampling from mixing dark+ivory into brown; choose broad connected regions and reduce excessive boundary length. Keep original pose/expression/proportions as closely as possible, no added elements, no crop, no mirror, no altered completion artwork. Clean warm hand-drawn 2D silhouette with smooth flat regions and readable identity.

calls.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: detailed color completion artwork for a hand-drawn nonogram album. Create ONE finished illustration of a great spotted woodpecker (Buntspecht), adult male with black crown, small red nape patch (NOT a red crown), white cheek, black moustache stripe, large ivory-white shoulder patch, black wings with distinct grouped white spots, pale warm ivory breast and scarlet undertail. A strong pointed grey chisel beak, sturdy climbing feet, stiff pointed supporting tail. Warm calm hand-drawn 2D illustration, clean confident dark contours, rich solid color masses, refined feather grouping, subtle restrained shading and purposeful interior detail. Neither pixel art nor a simplified flat icon: a polished detailed illustrated album reward. Quiet plain warm off-white background, no scenery or border, no writing or labels or watermark. All of the bird visible and unobscured, sufficient modest margins, portrait composition suitable for later abstraction at about 30 cells high, which is NOT to be drawn now. Anatomy plausible and beak/claws readable, avoid fine noisy feather scratches. Pose/composition A: classic upright left-facing full side profile, bird clinging on the LEFT SIDE of a narrow vertical warm-brown tree trunk that occupies the rightmost quarter; head turned slightly out from trunk so its long beak points to the left, clearly separated from trunk. Bird occupies most of the picture. Black-and-white shoulder and wing pattern in broad readable forms, red undertail above stiff long tail leaning toward trunk. Tree trunk is a supporting simple object with several broad bark details, no leaves.
